svg.title: Three repositories and their pins
svg.desc: sggs-data builds and publishes the scripture database; sggs-platform pins it by commit and sha256, serves the API and website, and publishes the golden contract; gurbani-soul-ios pins the contract at a platform release and builds its own database from the same dataset pin; this wiki pins the sibling repositories’ docs. One version number spans web, API and app.

text.font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
